build_gate.required_parent_decision: research-catalog-approved and explicit build authorization after at least 15 scenarios are researched
build_gate.schema_limit: This catalog specifies business research and draft export schemas, not an alternative scenario, result, trace, staging or runner contract.

common_design.input_packaging: Each shared-contract case remains one parseable JSON object. Preserve independent named logical export tables and a configurable role-to-filename mapping inside the case bundle. Final serialization is settled at build time; these are draft business schemas, not a new file resolver or prejoined answer.
configuration: Logical source filenames are configured by role, not hard-coded.
As-of dates, periods, thresholds and policy choices are explicit input data.
Exact joins and complete required date coverage; no fuzzy matching, silent deduplication or missing-as-zero defaults.
numeric_rules: Quantities and minor-unit money are integers, never booleans.
Money carries explicit currency; no mixed-currency totals.
Percentage rates use integer basis points.
Monetary intermediate values use exact decimal or rational arithmetic; round only at documented policy boundaries.
Arrays have documented stable ordering independent of source row order.
common_design.independent_expected_method: Write expected results manually from the documented procedure and arithmetic before baseline execution. Never derive, repair or copy goldens from baseline output. The research seed answers are not yet fixture or golden files.

connections.note: Exported synthetic file inputs and existing native file-output facilities only. No endpoint, authentication, account, payment token or backend is supplied or required. Real commerce integrations remain unverified.

common_design.baseline_boundary: After approval only: standard-library baseline solve(payload) returns the common result envelope and actual events, using the shared scenario_support.run_cli helper. No Creator/generated-plugin imports, expected-file reads, network calls or input mutation.
common_design.video_boundary: Foundation renders actual demo trace tables into a roughly 30-90 second video. Every frame identifies a Synthetic baseline execution visualization - not Cowork or a live system. Sector supplies meaningful actual intermediate events, not invented UI.

native_status.blocker: Approved Computer Use tools were removed; an unlocked accessible native session is also required.
native_status.note: No Playwright/browser/private API/cookie/token/shell/native workaround; no placeholder or local fake native ZIP. Actual native artifacts may later be saved under root output by the parent-authorized process.

scenarios.title: Store replenishment proposal with inventory and DC constraints

source_grounded_claims.claim: Inventory replenishment may end at manually reviewable recommendations rather than automatic orders or transfers.
Inventory positions, expected demand, replenishment lead times, planning horizons and capacity considerations inform supply planning.
Order quantities can be constrained to configured multiples.

source_limitations: The allocation, lost-demand and safety formulas below are mock company policy.
Ceiling raw need to whole cases differs from Microsoft's documented minimum-maximum multiple algorithm.
No live Oracle/Dynamics installation, inventory accuracy or backend connection is asserted.

actors.responsibility: Own the proposed allocation and review the shortages.
Provide dated synthetic store/DC and in-transit exports.
Provide remaining dispatch-day case capacity and review constraints.

scenarios.trigger: A human starts one dated replenishment-planning review from a closed synthetic export bundle.
scenarios.start: Unjoined stock snapshots, residual daily demand, inbound receipts, one route per store/SKU and policy.
scenarios.end: Whole-case proposal, daily physical projection, DC stock/capacity reconciliation and exception review packet.
no_live_actions: No shipment or physical stock movement
scope_limits: One source DC per store/SKU and one dispatch day.
No multi-DC optimization, substitutes, lots, expiry, routing, procurement or forecast training.

mock_file_schemas.validation: Partial allocation means whole cases; dates and filenames are explicit.
Start-of-as-of snapshot. Reserved and blocked are disjoint physical subsets whose sum cannot exceed on-hand.
Same as-of and disjoint-stock checks as store inventory.
Complete daily coverage for each routed store/SKU. Demand excludes already reserved commitments.
In-transit goods have left the origin. Received/cancelled rows have zero remaining units. No receipt is represented twice in stock and inbound.
Exactly one route per planned pair. No guessing between source DCs.
Remaining capacity is already net of firm work and is debited only for new hypothetical proposals.

sample_policy.rule: Available stock equals physical on-hand minus disjoint reserved and blocked units. Demand is residual unreserved demand, so the same commitment is not counted twice.
Arrival is as_of + lead_days. Coverage includes as_of through arrival + review_days - 1. Receipts arrive before the day's demand.

Count positive in-transit remaining quantities only on/after as_of and within coverage. Late receipts are listed but excluded; overdue in-transit evidence quarantines its pair; received/cancelled quantities contribute zero.
Walk pre-arrival days with nonnegative physical stock and record unfilled forecast as lost, never as a later backlog or actual negative stock.
After pre-arrival simulation, form post-arrival cumulative planning balances without the new receipt. Raw need is max(0, largest negative cumulative balance, safety - final cumulative balance).
Round raw need up to whole cases; record the rounding excess. This is not the vendor minimum-maximum algorithm.
Sort priority ascending, store_id, sku. Proposed cases are bounded by request, remaining whole cases of DC SKU stock and remaining dispatch-day case capacity. Debit each proposal exactly once.

If enabled, partial fulfillment is whole-case-only. If disabled and the full request cannot fit, propose zero and debit nothing. Every unproposed unit and binding limit is reported. Re-simulate with actual proposed quantities and expose dated loss and final safety shortfall. All three seed cases enable partial whole-case proposals.

independent_assertions: Proposed and requested units are nonnegative whole case-pack multiples.
No proposal exceeds its request, available DC SKU stock or dispatch-day case budget.

scenarios.title: Original-order returns and refund proposal reconciliation

source_grounded_claims.claim: Original transaction lookup, prior returned quantity and return reason support available-to-return reconciliation.
Linked refunds can be partial but are associated with a previously confirmed transaction and bounded by original authorization.
Offline quantities can be stale and partial-return tax handling must account for original tax.

source_limitations: Window length, conditions, partial-request policy and cumulative penny allocation are invented company policy.
No statutory return right, fraud conclusion or legal/payment approval is inferred.
Offline fixtures do not demonstrate real-time eligibility; live refund execution requires absent payment capabilities.

actors.responsibility: Prepare original-linked quantity and money proposals for review.
Provide synthetic request, condition and reason records.
Provide complete original-order/payment and opening return history exports.

scenarios.trigger: A human reviews a closed return-intake reporting period.
scenarios.start: Unjoined intake requests, original receipts/invoices/lines, posted opening returns and explicit company policy.
scenarios.end: Review-only per-request proposals and reconciled original/prior/proposed/remaining quantity and money controls.
no_live_actions: No fraud accusation or legal/policy entitlement judgment
scope_limits: Whole units; one invoice and one confirmed synthetic card-payment reference per original order.
Two-decimal currency with original merchandise and allocated tax; no shipping charges.
No exchanges, serialized goods, receiptless authorization, mixed tenders, multiple captures, tax recomputation or restocking fees.

mock_file_schemas.validation: Inclusive request period ending on/before as-of; all window/condition rules are mock policy.
One original invoice/payment reference per order; reference is not a token. Capture cannot exceed authorization.
Original line totals reconcile to captured amount; no unreported shipping or fee assumed.
Posted opening history strictly predates period_start. Posted consumes eligibility; voided does not; pending causes affected-order quarantine.
All supplied original identifiers must agree after exact joins; no fuzzy receipt or SKU matching.

sample_policy.rule: Opening posted history is complete strictly before period_start. Pending events, current-period posted history or impossible totals quarantine the affected order; never treat unresolved history as zero.
The demo window is 30 calendar days inclusive, with purchase <= request, request inside the inclusive period and period_end <= as_of. The configured window is not law.
Original returnability, configured reason and configured condition must pass. Nonreturnable, unknown or excluded items receive review-only zero proposals.
For original quantity Q and merchandise M/tax T, cumulative entitlement at q is half-up rounding of M*q/Q and T*q/Q in minor units. Never use a current price or recompute tax.

Prior posted quantity must be <= original quantity and prior amounts must equal the cumulative entitlements for that quantity. Original line totals must equal captured amount, which must be <= authorization; discrepancies quarantine order.

Process requested_on then request_id. Subtract posted history and earlier hypothetical proposals from fulfilled quantity. Partial-enabled requests propose min(requested, remaining); partial-disabled oversized requests propose zero and consume nothing.

Refund proposal for a additional units after r returned/proposed units is entitlement(r+a)-entitlement(r) for merchandise and tax separately. Check prior plus current proposals against capture/authorization.
Publish all request dispositions and projected controls with action_authorized=false. Original payment confirmation is evidence in a fixture, not execution permission.

scenarios.title: Store/SKU/date promotion price audit with exception review

source_grounded_claims.claim: Store-scoped price reports support date-bound and historical price review with export for further analysis.
Status, currency, unit and product/channel scope filter discounts; exclusions override inclusions.
Priority, exclusive/best/compound modes and rounding configuration can change expected prices.

source_limitations: No claim of full Dynamics pricing-engine compatibility.
Half-open date windows, selected hierarchy, exact tie ordering, final half-up rounding and tolerance are sample policy.
R8's enable-parameter instruction is superseded by R7's October2023 removal note; no native setup is performed.
The source report's seven-day limit is not a universal file-audit policy.

actors.responsibility: Compare expected and observed synthetic unit prices and own the review packet.
Supply reference prices, promotion definitions and store/SKU scopes.
Supply synthetic dated observed unit prices.
Review discrepancies and the mock approved-exception evidence.

scenarios.trigger: A human starts an explicitly scoped historical or current-period unit-price audit.
scenarios.start: Unjoined observation, store/product, date-versioned base price, promotion/scope and exception exports.
scenarios.end: Full observation disposition, rule-selection ledger, expected-versus-observed comparison and review-only issue packet.
scope_limits: One-unit tax-exclusive two-decimal-currency prices and exact store/SKU scope.
Dates already normalized to each store's local calendar; no timezone or DST inference.
No basket, quantity, threshold, loyalty, coupon, affiliation, personalized, shipping or conversion rules.

mock_file_schemas.validation: Half-open audit window; final included day <= as_of.
Unique synthetic store; no currency conversion.
Unique SKU with explicit unit; no variant or unit conversion inference.
Exactly one date-applicable base per observation; overlaps/missing bases are not-evaluable evidence.
Amount-off values are minor units; percent-off values are1..10000 basis points. Unsupported types are not silently reinterpreted.
All foreign keys resolve. Exclusion overrides matching inclusion; no wildcard scope inference.
At most one active approved exception per observation; approval reference is synthetic, not actual business authorization.
Observed unit price only, not an order or sales amount.

sample_policy.rule: All audit, base, promotion and approved-exception windows use start <= local observed date < end. Out-of-audit observations are listed separately. Invalid/reversed windows or future audit coverage reject.
Exactly one active base is required. Missing/overlapping base evidence or two active approved exceptions makes affected observations not evaluable, never zero-priced.
An eligible promotion is enabled, active on the observation date, same currency/unit, explicitly included for store/SKU and not explicitly excluded.
One active approved exception sets expected price. Otherwise choose the highest numeric priority among eligible promotions; no lower-priority stacking.
If exclusive candidates exist at that priority, only they compete; choose the lowest unrounded result and suppress all other modes.

Without exclusive candidates, compare each best-price single against the combined compound set. Compound subtracts total amount-off with floor zero, then applies all percentage factors without intermediate rounding.
Compare unrounded results; exact ties select the lexicographically sorted promotion-ID tuple and record tied candidates, independent of source order.
Round the selected final expected price once to integer minor units using half-up. Delta=observed-expected. Mismatch only when abs(delta)>configured tolerance.
Publish all included/excluded/not-evaluable observations and explanations with action_authorized=false. Do not infer financial loss, legal violation or a price change.

independent_assertions: Every winner matches status, date, store, SKU, currency, unit and include/exclude rules.
Disabled, excluded and expired promotions never win.
Priority precedes competition; exclusive discounts never stack with other modes.
One approved exception replaces promotional pricing only within its active window.
Ambiguous base/exception evidence cannot produce a numeric expected price.
Exact compound and half-up calculations match the independently derived719,1000,905 and875 examples.
The observed price never influences expected-price selection.
All observations appear exactly once across matched, mismatched, not-evaluable and out-of-scope totals.
Exact candidate ties are deterministic and visibly documented, not settled by input order.
Input permutations, changed row counts and role-filename remapping preserve the procedure.
